content: We further sample an English-Russian sentence pair from the MultiUN validation sets and visualize the cosine similarity between hidden states of the top encoder layer to further investigate the difference of all cross-lingual pre-training methods. As shown in Figure FIGREF38, the hidden states generated by MLM+BRLM-SA have higher similarity for two aligned words. It indicates that MLM+BRLM-SA can gain better word-level representation alignment between source and pivot languages, which better relieves the burden of the domain shift problem.
